newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper ends firmer after choppy session.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper ends firmer after choppy session.

text.p: COMEX copper ended slightly firmer after a day of generally routine trading with little fresh fundamental news while much of the interest in base metals was focused on nickel and aluminum.
After an initial rally, the market slipped back below 114.00 cents per pound in the March contract to trade choppily in a relatively narrow range in modest volume.
March COMEX copper settled 0.40 cent firmer at 113.70 cents per pound, traded 114.60 to 112.35 cents.
Some traders said they expected a modest dip of about 3,000 tonnes in LME stocks Tuesday.
The backwardation on LME remained stable on Monday, at $70/$74 by COMEX close.
